title: Spain to build camp for migrant strawberry pickers after UN calls out 'deplorable conditions' - InfoMigrants
summary: Following fires in cramped migrant worker settlements in southwest Spain and subsequent criticism by a UN official about "deplorable conditions" there, Spanish soldiers were deployed over the weekend to build a camp for migrant strawberry pickers.
